description: GROUP-USAGE clause (a bit group / national group: the group item is treated as an elementary item of usage bit and category boolean, or usage national and category national), ISO §2023:13.18.29 — introduced 2002 (GROUP-USAGE is a 2002 reserved word). Data-model design D20; kb/Work PB79.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. GUSG9AL.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 NG GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL.
   05 N1 PIC N(2) VALUE N"ab".
   05 N2 PIC N(1) VALUE N"c".
01 NR PIC N(3).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE NG TO NR.
    IF NR = N"abc" DISPLAY "OK" ELSE DISPLAY "BAD" END-IF.
    STOP RUN.
